app-templates.message:
feat(quiz, explainer): dark mode that follows the system

## Intent

Quiz and explainer apps showed only light colours. Learners who use a dark system setting should get a dark page in both archetypes.

## Key changes

- Both stylesheets switch to dark values when the system asks for it (prefers-color-scheme: dark): text, background, borders, accent, and the colours for right and wrong. The colour scheme is "light dark", so form controls switch too.
- In the explainer, example and note boxes, the syntax colours of code and the white-on-accent texts also use the colour variables.
- The explainer's SVG figures carry CSS classes, so they change colour in dark mode; their colour attributes stay as a fallback.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The dark colours were chosen by eye; the 4.5:1 contrast is not measured yet.
- The interactive archetype has no dark mode yet.
